{{Short description|Irish entomologist}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2025}}

'''James Patrick O'Connor''' is an Irish [[entomologist]] and a member of the [[Royal Irish Academy]].<ref name="mria" /> He is an alumnus of the [[National University of Ireland]] (BSc 1970, PhD 1975).<ref name="mria" /> From 1988 to 2000, he was the [[curator|keeper]] of the [[National Museum of Ireland – Natural History|Natural History Museum]] in Dublin.<ref name="viney" /> He is the editor of the ''Bulletin of the Irish Biogeographical Society''.{{efn|''Bull. Ir. Biogeogr. Soc.'' {{ISSN|0332-1185}} {{OCLC|14151931}}}}<ref name="IBSeditor" />

==Selected works==
* {{cite book |last1=O'Connor |first1=James P. |last2=Ashe |first2=Patrick |others=Illustrated by Sean Milne |title=Irish indoor insects : a guide to Irish indoor insect pests |date=2000 |publisher=Town House |location=Dublin |isbn=978-1-86059-095-5 |url=https://archive.org/details/irishindoorinsec0000ocon}}<ref name="Reynolds2" /><ref name="Caden" />
* {{cite book |last1=O'Connor |first1=James P. |last2=Nelson |first2=Brian |title=An Annotated Checklist of the Irish Hemiptera and Small Orders |date=2012 |publisher=Irish Biogeographical Society |isbn=978-0-9550806-7-8 |url=https://irishbiogeographicalsociety.com/pdf/web18Oconnornelsoannotatedhemipterasmallorders.pdf |language=en }}<ref name="Reynolds" />
* {{cite book |last1=O'Connor |first1=James P. |title=A Catalogue and Atlas of the Caddisflies (Trichoptera) of Ireland |date=2015 |publisher=Irish Biogeographical Society |isbn=978-0-9550806-8-5 |url=https://www.irishbiogeographicalsociety.com/pdf/OConnorCaddisflies-Trichoptera-ofIreland.pdf |language=en }}<ref name="viney" /><ref name="Nelson" /><ref name="Feeley" />
* {{cite book |last1=O'Connor |first1=James P. |title=Bibliography of Irish Insects (1802-2020) |date=2023 |publisher=Irish Biogeographical Society |isbn=978-1-9164218-3-7 |url=https://irishbiogeographicalsociety.com/pdf/bibliographyofirishinsects-1802-2020-.pdf |language=en }}<ref name="O'Hanlon" />
